voices.structuralist: Through the labyrinthine streets of New Erebus, the twisted, gothic spire of the Oni-Kiru tower pierced the smog-choked sky like a shard of splintered glass.

voices.futurist: Khaos, the city's sentient flesh, whispered secrets to the wind: 'I am hungry, feed me with the dreams of my children'.
